name: pg_subselect_planner_error_estimating
goal:
The planner can fail with "no relation entry for relid N" while estimating a SubPlan whose test expression contains an aggregate expression from the parent query.

    explain (costs off)
    select (1 = any(array_agg(f1))) = any (select false) from int4_tbl;

The query has to plan and return true. The SubPlan's test expression must still contribute to its estimated cost, and no existing plan or row estimate may change.
